about: The plugin's rule as byte patches to official clang releases that can load no plugin (a Windows clang.exe
exports none of LLVM's symbols). zkit applies a patch to a copy of the official binary whose SHA-256 is the
patch's `sha256`, checks each edit's `old` bytes first and the result against `patched_sha256`, and compiles
the plugin's units with the copy (build.patched_clang). Each edits LLVM's cxxDtorIsEmpty
(lib/Transforms/IPO/GlobalOpt.cpp), which GlobalOpt's OptimizeEmptyGlobalCXXDtors asks whether a guarded
static's destructor is empty before it drops the static's __cxa_atexit call, into LLVM 9's version
(llvm-project 6e679f8, r353603): the destructor is empty only when its entry block, debug intrinsics aside,
starts with `ret`. Up to LLVM 8 it is also empty when its one block calls only empty functions and has no
other side effects. Offsets are file offsets; each `why` names the instruction (virtual address) it changes.

patches.release: LLVM 3.9.1 for Windows x86-64, LLVM-3.9.1-win64.exe: bin/clang.exe (clang++.exe and clang-cl.exe are the same file)
patches.function: cxxDtorIsEmpty at 0x140c27da0 (the function that calls itself and compares the instruction kinds Call 0x4e and Ret 0x19); its one other caller is the inlined OptimizeEmptyGlobalCXXDtors at 0x140c2036e

edits.why: 0x140c27de4 je -> jmp: a destructor of more than one block is no longer refused, only its entry block is read
0x140c27e90 mov rbx, [rdi-0x18] -> xor ebx, ebx: a call that is not a debug intrinsic reads as a call to an unknown function, so the destructor is not empty (the callee is not examined)
0x140c27f31 mov rcx, rdi -> jmp 0x140c27f51 (return false): any other instruction but `ret` makes the destructor not empty, side effects or not
